description: Submit a scrape job to run ASYNCHRONOUSLY and return a `job_id` immediately, instead of holding the connection open. Use this for long-running scrapes (heavy JS rendering, full-page screenshots of long pages) — for a quick one-shot fetch prefer the synchronous `scrape` tool, which blocks and returns the page directly. Poll the job with `scrape_status` and fetch the page with `scrape_result` once done. Takes `extract.elements` like `scrape` (named values by CSS selector, no extra credits); the result carries them in `elements`. Rules: https://crawlbrulee.com/docs/scrape/elements. Optionally attach a per-job completion `webhook`: we deliver a single signed `scrape.complete` POST to your endpoint when the job finishes (HTTPS required in production), and echoes your opaque `webhook.metadata` back in the delivery (under `data.metadata`, alongside `data.page_status_code` (on success) and `data.response_meta.usage`). Set `zero_data_retention: true` to keep the result out of the shared cache; anything stored to deliver it is kept for 24 hours, then deleted. It adds 1 credit and must be enabled for the organization (else a `zero_data_retention_not_enabled` error, not billed). See https://crawlbrulee.com/docs/zero-data-retention.

max_age.description: Maximum cache age in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime cutoff

cleanup.description: What is removed from the page before any output is built. Applies to markdown, cleaned_html, links and images on every engine, and to the screenshot. Never applies to raw_html, which is always the page before we removed anything.

ads_and_popups.description: Remove ads, cookie banners, consent dialogs and chat widgets. Defaults to true. Also affects the screenshot. Set it to false to capture the page as-is, or to get past a site that refuses to serve an ad-blocking client.

exclude_selectors.description: CSS selectors whose elements are removed before anything is captured. Affects the extracted content and the screenshot, never raw_html. Use it for a banner or widget that ads_and_popups does not recognise. Sending any selector here makes the request skip the cache.

extract.description: Which content formats to extract. Defaults to metadata + cleaned_html.

cleaned_html.description: Extract cleaned HTML: the page body with scripts, styles, ads and cookie banners removed

all.description: Return every match as a list instead of the first. Defaults to false

attribute.description: The attribute to read when `output` is `attribute`. `href` and `src` come back as full urls

fields.description: Used instead of `output`: turns each match into an object of named values, each read inside that match only. Same shape as `elements`; nests up to 3 levels

output.description: What to return for a match: `text` (default), `html` (the outer HTML) or `attribute`

elements.description: Named values to read from the page by CSS selector, returned in the top-level `elements` field under the same names. Each value is either a selector string (the text of the first match) or an object with `selector`, `output`, `attribute` and `all`. `fields` (instead of `output`) turns each match into an object of named values read inside that match only, so a list of product cards can return a title, price and url per card. A name with no match is null, or [] with `all: true`. Read after cleanup; `<script>` and `<style>` tags are not part of it. An invalid selector is a 400. No extra credits, also when the page comes from cache. Limits and selector rules: https://crawlbrulee.com/docs/scrape/elements.

images.description: Extract inline images found on the page, up to 10,000 per page. Beyond that the array is truncated and the response carries an `inline_images_truncated` warning.

links.description: Extract links found on the page, up to 30,000 per page. Beyond that the array is truncated and the response carries a `links_truncated` warning.

markdown.description: Extract page content as clean Markdown

metadata.description: Extract page metadata (title, description, OG tags, etc.) from the page head

raw_html.description: Return the raw, unprocessed HTML, up to 10,000,000 characters of page body. A larger body is truncated at a tag boundary and the response carries a `raw_html_truncated` warning.

screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot of the page

actions_after.description: Actions to perform after taking the screenshot (e.g. slice into tiles)

height.description: Height of each tile in pixels (minimum 500)

type.description: Slice the screenshot into horizontal tiles

actions_before.description: Actions to perform before taking the screenshot (wait, scroll)

type.description: Wait for a duration before capturing

pixels.description: Pixels to scroll (positive = down, negative = up)

device_mode.description: Emulate desktop or mobile device viewport

viewport.description: Custom viewport dimensions; uses device_mode defaults if omitted

device_scale_factor.description: Device pixel ratio (1–3, fractional allowed; e.g. 2 for Retina). Defaults to 1.

location.description: Optional locale + country emulation for the scrape

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. 'us', 'de', 'br'; case-insensitive) driving the emulated browser timezone and proxy exit country. Also accepts 'eu' (random EU member state) or 'europe' (random European state incl. UK and non-EU).

locale.description: BCP-47 locale (2-35 chars, e.g. 'en-US', 'de-DE', 'pt-BR') driving Accept-Language and navigator.language

proxy.description: Proxy tier to use for fetching

require_js.description: Use a headless browser to render JavaScript before scraping

url.description: The URL to scrape. Known tracking parameters are removed before the page is fetched, so they are neither sent to the target site nor part of the cache key. Every other query parameter is kept verbatim and is part of the cache key.

webhook.description: Completion webhook delivered when this async job finishes. Async-only: the synchronous `scrape` tool does not accept it.

metadata.description: Opaque correlation object echoed verbatim in the webhook payload’s data.metadata. Must serialize to at most 2048 bytes (UTF-8 JSON). Use it to route deliveries without keeping your own job_id mapping.

url.description: Endpoint that receives a single signed POST when the job reaches a terminal state. Must be an http/https URL (HTTPS is required in production) of at most 2048 characters. The body is a `scrape.complete` envelope signed with your organization webhook secret on the X-Cwbl-Signature header.

zero_data_retention.description: Keeps the result out of the shared cache; anything stored to deliver it is kept for 24 hours, then deleted. Adds 1 credit. Must be enabled for your organization. See https://crawlbrulee.com/docs/zero-data-retention.

name: scrape_async

job_id.description: Job identifier — pass it to the `scrape_status` / `scrape_result` tools

title: Scrape a URL asynchronously
